BlackRock Credit Allocation Income Trust의 이사 Lorenzo Flores는 2026년 10월 1일 BlackRock Deferred Compensation Plan에 따라 1,064.09 Performance Rights를 취득했습니다. 해당 보상은 $9.34 per share로 기록되며, 그 결과 그의 직접 보유 포지션은 21,697.54 Performance Rights였습니다.

각 권리는 신탁의 1주에 해당하는 현금가치로 전환 가능하며, Flores가 선택한 이연 기간 동안 권리는 현금으로 100% 결제됩니다.

Performance Rights F1, F2, F3

Holdings After Transaction: Performance Rights — 21,697.54 contracts (Direct)

F1. The Performance Rights were accrued under the BlackRock Deferred Compensation Plan.

F2. One Performance Right is convertible into the cash value of one share of BlackRock Credit Allocation Income Trust.

F3. The Performance Rights are to be settled 100% in cash at the deferral period chosen by the reporting person.

Performance Rights acquired 1,064.09 Performance Rights Award to Lorenzo Flores on October 1, 2026

Reported per-share amount $9.34 per share Performance Rights award

Resulting direct position 21,697.54 Performance Rights Lorenzo Flores after the October 1, 2026 award

Performance rights are conditional awards that give employees or executives the promise of receiving company shares or cash only if the business meets specific targets or survives for a set period. They work like a bonus you only get when certain goals are hit, so they matter to investors because they can increase the number of shares outstanding (dilution), signal management’s incentives and confidence in future results, and affect per-share earnings and valuation.
